records.inherited_baseline: 宋初已启动《开宝藏》雕造，但尚未完成；五代乱后典籍版片散失，国家亦无同等规模的多类大型总集
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 宋初雕版条件已成熟，但完整大藏经和多部千卷级编纂仍需异常高的国家组织成本
records.background_trend: 印刷扩张是背景；《开宝藏》983年完成、版片入京和印经传播，以及太宗多部大型知识工程属于其窗口的可归责增量
records.attributable_change: 太平兴国八年完成《开宝藏》雕造并把完整印刷大藏经纳入国家与跨区域宗教传播链；同时诏修《太平御览》《太平广记》《文苑英华》等大型类书总集，保存大量前代文献并形成持续使用
records.field_coverage: completed printed Buddhist canon plus encyclopedia, narrative and literary-anthology corpora across distinct knowledge scenes
records.durability_and_handoff: the completed canon and compendia became durable textual lineages with later transregional use
records.cross_scene_replication: printed religious canon, encyclopedia, narrative collection and literary anthology are independent production/transmission chains

counterevidence.summary: immediate public access varied by work and technical authorship belonged to specialist teams; these cap any CIV4 claim

records.inherited_baseline: 唐五代实录和国史材料尚存但分散且面临散佚
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 成熟官僚与雕版条件使大型类书可行，但千卷规模的整理仍非自然趋势
records.background_trend: 北宋官修类书传统已由太宗开创，真宗窗口只消费新项目的完成与保存结果
records.attributable_change: 诏修并持续过问千卷《册府元龟》，保存大量唐五代实录、国史和制度文献；成书后的当期流通主要限于国家与少数抄本网络
records.field_coverage: one thousand-volume historical-institutional compendium preserving a very large source corpus
records.durability_and_handoff: the work preserved extensive now-lost Tang and Five-Dynasties sources across later centuries

counterevidence.summary: completion and preservation are clear, but broad contemporary circulation is not

records.inherited_baseline: 元符末已有地方官学和太学基础，但没有崇宁规模的州县学校扩张、辟雍容量和独立画学人才培养通道
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 成熟印刷与宋代财政行政使学校网络扩张可行，因此需按实际运行、专业入口和财政可持续性裁决，不因名义校数自动升档
records.background_trend: 北宋教育扩张是长期趋势；只消费崇宁窗口新增供给、实际教学和画学考试入仕通道
records.attributable_change: 崇宁时期大扩州县学校与辟雍供给；崇宁三年另设画学，设置专业课程、考试和入仕/画院人才出口，形成独立的艺术专业教育通道。基层实施和财政压力明显，后续稳定性不足
records.field_coverage: wide prefectural-county and capital school expansion plus a distinct professional painting-school pipeline; access remained elite and urban weighted
records.durability_and_handoff: some school institutions and artistic training effects persisted, but fiscal retrenchment and political reversal cap durability
records.cross_scene_replication: general school network and specialist painting education are independent B-axis access scenes

counterevidence.summary: fiscal burden and uneven local realization prevent R3; two R2 scenes strengthen HIGH band only

records.inherited_baseline: imperial art collections existed without the same large systematic painting and calligraphy catalogues
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: mature court collecting and printing made cataloguing feasible, but palace-only access sharply limits public knowledge value
records.background_trend: collecting culture pre-existed; only the completed cataloguing, classification and preserved descriptions are consumed
records.attributable_change: 组织宫廷收藏整理并形成《宣和画谱》《宣和书谱》等大型目录，记录画家、作品、流派和收藏信息，为后世保存大量艺术史资料；但原收藏和当期使用高度集中于宫廷
records.field_coverage: painting and calligraphy catalogues covering thousands of works and hundreds of creators, with narrow contemporary access
records.durability_and_handoff: catalogue information survived and became a durable art-historical source even where objects later dispersed
records.cross_scene_replication: painting and calligraphy cataloguing are related preservation scenes

counterevidence.summary: palace concentration and limited contemporaneous public access cap this at R2

records.inherited_baseline: 元祐系学者、著述、书板及其家族门生网络在徽宗初仍有较大表达、传播与仕进空间
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 成熟雕版与科举网络使知识传播广泛，也使全国性禁书、党籍和教育排斥的破坏更深
records.background_trend: 新旧党争是继承背景；只消费徽宗本人窗口多轮党籍、禁书毁板、禁元祐学术和牵连子孙等实际政策结果
records.attributable_change: 崇宁以后多次立元祐党籍碑并全国刊刻，禁毁元祐学者著述和书板、限制其学术传授与仕进，并牵连部分子孙；中间虽有短暂松动，但随后又恢复和加重，形成跨文本、学校科举和士人网络的系统性知识生态收缩
records.field_coverage: named scholar networks, books and printing blocks, teaching, examinations and descendant career access across the realm
records.durability_and_handoff: repeated relaxations prevent R4, but destruction, exclusion and chilling effects operated for substantial portions of the reign
records.cross_scene_replication: party steles, book destruction, teaching restrictions and career exclusion are independent harm scenes

counterevidence.summary: some prohibitions were temporarily relaxed and the same reign preserved major art catalogues; these reduce band but do not erase the hard negative

records.inherited_baseline: Buddhist canonical texts circulated as dispersed manuscripts without a state-organized full-canon carving project
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: woodblock printing could support a large canonical corpus but required exceptional state coordination
records.background_trend: printing was expanding, but the 971 imperial order and organized carving program were attributable ruler actions
records.attributable_change: 971年下令在成都启动《开宝藏》雕造并组织大规模版刻工程；本人窗口只消费项目创建、国家组织和任内已经完成的雕造增量，不消费983年竣工、完整印本和后续广泛传播
records.field_coverage: one exceptionally large Buddhist canonical carving project with substantial realized work but no completed canon within the ruler window
records.durability_and_handoff: the project successfully handed off and was completed under Zhao Guangyi; successor completion validates continuity but is not backfilled

counterevidence.summary: the canon was not completed until 983 under the successor; complete printed-canon transmission therefore cannot support R3 personal credit

records.inherited_baseline: 庆历兴学已留下州县官学基础，但太学尚无三舍进阶体系，地方官学的教授、学田与稳定供给仍不充分
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 成熟印刷和宋代行政能力使扩大教育网络可行，因此只消费熙宁窗口新增的实际供给与进阶通道，不把宋代教育整体繁荣归给本人
records.background_trend: 庆历官学和印刷扩展是继承基线；三舍法、熙宁地方立学、教授与学田配置属于新增机制
records.attributable_change: 太学三舍法扩大中央教育容量并形成由学习考核通向仕进的分级路径；熙宁兴学又在多路州郡设置或强化学校、教授与学田供给，构成中央进阶体系与多地域地方教育扩张的并行结果
records.field_coverage: central higher-education progression plus multi-region prefectural school supply; access remained concentrated among male literate elites and implementation was uneven
records.durability_and_handoff: 三舍法及地方学校改革形成后续教育制度基础，但党争与后续调整限制稳定性，故不进R3
records.cross_scene_replication: Taixue progression and multi-region local school supply are distinct education-access scenes

counterevidence.summary: 庆历已有地方官学基线，且社会身份和地域实现不均；这些限制其为CIV2-HIGH而非R3

records.inherited_baseline: schools and examinations retained multiple inherited commentary traditions
records.attributable_change: 三经新义成为学校科举唯一程式并排挤旧注
records.field_coverage: the Three Classics New Meanings became the exclusive school-exam standard and displaced older commentaries

records.inherited_baseline: the targeted Yuanyou texts and teaching networks remained available
records.attributable_change: 元祐文集书板焚毁并禁止聚徒传授
records.field_coverage: targeted political-intellectual corpus and its teaching transmission, not the whole knowledge field
records.durability_and_handoff: boards were destroyed and teaching prohibited in the window; wider long-term closure is not claimed

records.inherited_baseline: private academies and uneven local official schools existed without a stable realm-wide expectation that prefectures and qualified counties sustain schools linked to central teaching reform
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: printing and dense Song administration made wider supply feasible, so structural reach is judged relative to an already more developed educational frontier than early empires
records.background_trend: printing and urban growth improved conditions; the Qingli school orders, professors, study rules and Taixue pedagogy were discrete ruler-window changes
records.attributable_change: 庆历兴学把此前零散地方官学推进为州府军监普遍立学、符合条件者设县学的更广教育层级，并设置教授、在学规则；应天书院官学化与胡瑗教学法进入太学形成中央—地方联动
records.field_coverage: prefectural schools across the realm, qualified county schools, official academy conversion and central Taixue pedagogy; realization remained uneven
records.durability_and_handoff: the school layer and pedagogical reforms survived the immediate failure of the New Policies and provided a base for later Song expansion
records.cross_scene_replication: prefectural/county schools, academy conversion and Taixue pedagogy

counterevidence.summary: implementation was geographically uneven and social access remained limited; these cap CIV3 to LOW

records.inherited_baseline: medical texts lacked the same state collation-publication package and the secret collection remained incomplete
records.attributable_change: 国家校定刊印医书并铸针灸铜人；秘阁购募保存古书书画
records.field_coverage: medical publication and acupuncture teaching tools in one professional field plus narrow preservation activity

records.inherited_baseline: competing scholarly networks retained examination, textual, and teaching access
records.attributable_change: 庆元伪学禁由学术排斥扩至科举和书籍后逐步解除
records.field_coverage: the Qingyuan ban extended exclusion across scholarship, examinations, books, and teaching before gradual relaxation

records.inherited_baseline: 靖康之变与南渡使北宋中央学校和大量地方教育、科举运行遭到战争性断裂
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 南宋财政与行政在立国后能够逐步恢复教育，但从战时流亡考试到稳定太学、州学和定期取士仍需持续国家组织
records.background_trend: 士人南迁和印刷传统有利于恢复；只消费高宗窗口科举持续运行、太学重建、州学修复与教官供给的实际恢复结果
records.attributable_change: 南渡战乱中维持并调整科举，政权稳定后重建太学并扩充生员，绍兴十二年前后推动州县修学、教官与学校供给恢复，形成南宋可持续的教育—考试—仕进基本网络
records.field_coverage: central Taixue plus multi-region local schools and recurring examination access; still centered on male literati and uneven local recovery
records.durability_and_handoff: the restored Southern Song school-examination structure survived Gaozong and became the successor baseline
records.cross_scene_replication: wartime examination continuity, central Taixue rebuilding and multi-region local-school restoration

counterevidence.summary: this rebuilt an inherited Song model rather than creating education from zero, and access remained elite; therefore CIV3 band is LOW

records.inherited_baseline: 南渡后的经籍定本和太学石经体系缺乏新的完整恢复工程
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 雕版已成熟，但皇帝亲书、太学刻石并向州学传播的经典定本仍属高成本国家知识工程
records.background_trend: 经学与印刷传统是继承背景；只消费高宗本人书写、刻石和教育网络采用的增量
records.attributable_change: 亲书多部儒家经典，命在太学刻成绍兴石经，并通过拓本等方式进入学校和士人使用网络，形成南宋初期稳定经典文本与书写知识公共品
records.field_coverage: multiple canonical texts fixed in stone and used through the education network, but not a cross-field knowledge paradigm
records.durability_and_handoff: stone texts and rubbings provided durable textual preservation and later scholarly use

counterevidence.summary: the project is major but remains a classics textual-standardization scene and does not reach R3 by itself

records.inherited_baseline: 南渡初士人仍保有较大的程学讲授、私史撰述和私人记录空间
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 战时政治风险并不必然要求长期排斥一整学术传统或禁止私人修史并奖励告发
records.background_trend: 秦桧主导政治压制是重要机制，但高宗本人批准、支持并在诏令中表达禁私史立场，个人归责闭合
records.attributable_change: 绍兴时期长期排斥程氏之学及其士人网络；又禁止私修国史、要求州县侦察告发并处罚相关撰述者，高宗本人明确支持禁私史，形成跨学术传承、历史书写与士人表达安全的持续收缩
records.field_coverage: Cheng-school teaching and scholar networks plus private historical writing, local surveillance and denunciation
records.durability_and_handoff: suppression lasted for substantial portions of the reign; later relaxation prevents R4 but does not erase realized losses and chilling effects
records.cross_scene_replication: academic exclusion and private-history repression are independent knowledge-ecology harm scenes

counterevidence.summary: some restrictions later relaxed and the same reign produced the Shaoxing Stone Classics; these keep the final negative at CIV2-MID after netting

records.inherited_baseline: 高宗朝已经重建稳定的太学、地方官学与科举网络，但落第举人与太学之间缺少孝宗朝同等的开放补试入口
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 南宋成熟教育和科举体系可以扩大太学补试，但容量和财政约束决定无限开放难以持续
records.background_trend: 太学与科举本身是继承基线；只消费孝宗窗口混补开放和随后待补限额所产生的实际人才流动变化
records.attributable_change: 孝宗实行混补，每三年科举后允许全部落第举人参加太学补试，显著扩大科举失败者继续进入中央高等教育的替代入口；后因应试者过多改为待补，仅从诸路解试终场人中按约百分之六送试，说明原扩张真实但同一窗口内明显回收
records.field_coverage: empire-wide examination losers initially received an alternative Taixue test route, later limited to a selected six-percent feeder pool
records.durability_and_handoff: the admission mechanism remained part of Southern Song Taixue selection, but its broadest form did not persist

counterevidence.summary: the broad mixed-admission opening was curtailed because of excessive applicants, and no new school layer was created; final result is CIV1-HIGH rather than CIV2
